input.quote: (e) THE EXPRESS WARRANTIES IN THIS AGREEMENT SHALL BE IN LIEU OF ALL OTHER WARRANTIES, EXPRESS OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING THE IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY, FITNESS FOR A PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
input.rationale: Section 5 warrants only legality of performance, authority/rights and non-infringement; there is no warranty that the Services or Works will conform to the Specifications, no warranty period, no malicious-code warranty and no repair/replace/re-perform/refund remedy. The professional-and-workmanlike standard in Paragraph 1(b) is a performance covenant only, and Paragraph 5(e) disclaims all implied warranties (including merchantability and fitness), leaving Clear Capital with no conformance protection. Added a new Paragraph 5(f) with a 12-month deliverable/software and 90-day services conformance warranty, no-malicious-code warranty, express remedy at Contractor's option, and a carve-out from the disclaimer; fallback is 90/30 days with the same remedies.

proposal.summary: Add express performance/conformance warranty with repair, replace, re-perform or refund remedy, carved out of the disclaimer
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 5 contains legal, rights and IP representations but no warranty that the Services and Works will actually conform to the Specifications, and no remedy if they do not, while Paragraph 5(e) disclaims all implied warranties. We added a 12-month deliverable/software conformance warranty (90 days for Services), a no-malicious-code warranty and a repair/replace/re-perform-or-refund remedy; we can accept 90 days for deliverables and 30 days for Services if needed.

ops.text: (f) Contractor represents and warrants that (i) the Services will be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner in accordance with industry standards; (ii) for a period of twelve (12) months following delivery (or ninety (90) days following performance, in the case of Services that do not result in a deliverable), the Works and each deliverable will conform in all material respects to the applicable Specifications and accompanying documentation; and (iii) the Works will not contain any virus, malicious code or other routine intended to disable or harm Company's systems or data. For any breach of this warranty, Contractor shall, at its option, re-perform the affected Services, repair or replace the non-conforming Works or deliverable, or refund the fees paid for the non-conforming Services, Works or deliverable. The express warranties in this Paragraph 5(f) are not limited, waived or disclaimed by Paragraph 5(e).
